description: This file implements proxy bypass rules logic for network proxy resolution, including platform-specific implicit rules, hostname and IP address checks, and rule parsing and evaluation.

classes.name: BypassSimpleHostnamesRule
classes.description: Rule that matches hostnames with no dots and not IP addresses, used for bypassing simple hostnames.

classes.name: SubtractImplicitBypassesRule
classes.description: Rule that matches implicit bypass rules such as localhost, loopback, and local IP ranges.

methods.name: IsLinkLocalIP
methods.description: Checks if a URL's host is a link-local IP address.

methods.name: IsIPv4MappedLoopback
methods.description: Checks if a URL's host is an IPv6 literal in the IPv4-mapped range corresponding to localhost.

methods.name: ProxyBypassRules::Matches
methods.description: Determines if a URL matches the bypass rules, considering implicit rules and optional reversal.

methods.name: ProxyBypassRules::ParseFromString
methods.description: Parses a string to set up bypass rules.

methods.name: ProxyBypassRules::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the bypass rules to a string.

methods.name: ProxyBypassRules::MatchesImplicitRules
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the platform-specific implicit bypass rules.
